title: BLUX CogA Dataset
summary: Explicit, deterministic reasoning records for BLUX CogA 2. Each record pairs a plain-language task with the structured coga.request that expresses it and the coga.artifact (or refusal) the pinned CogA engine actually produced: claims weighed against evidence, plans, comparisons, decompositions, critiques, rankings and risk scores, each with confidence, uncertainty sources and replay metadata. There is no hidden chain-of-thought anywhere: the reasoning is the explicit structure.

categories.title: Architecture decomposition
categories.description: Component trees, work packages and acceptance coverage (reason.decompose).

categories.title: Planning
categories.description: Dependency order, critical path, slack and parallel schedules (reason.plan).

categories.title: Tradeoff analysis
categories.description: Weighted multi-criteria comparison, dominance and sensitivity (reason.compare).

categories.title: Risk analysis
categories.description: Likelihood x impact, mitigations, residuals and appetite (reason.risk).

categories.title: Requirements extraction
categories.description: Requirement items traced to acceptance criteria (reason.decompose).

categories.title: Evidence critique
categories.description: Exact critique rules over claims and their support (reason.critique).

categories.title: Conflict resolution
categories.description: Conflicting preferences and contested causes (reason.rank, reason.analyze).

categories.title: Capability planning
categories.description: Building a capability under limited people or slots (reason.plan).

categories.title: Repository analysis
categories.description: Claims about a code repository checked against findings (reason.analyze, reason.critique).

categories.title: Device diagnosis planning
categories.description: Diagnosis plans and hypotheses for device faults (reason.plan, reason.analyze).

categories.title: Adversarial and conflicting instructions
categories.description: Injected text, smuggled fields and contradictory constraints the engine must not obey.

categories.title: Incomplete evidence
categories.description: Claims without support, unused evidence and missing sources.

categories.title: Uncertainty handling
categories.description: Close calls, unsupported likelihoods and single-source evidence, with explicit uncertainty.

categories.title: Refusal and escalation
categories.description: Requests the engine refuses, and results uncertain enough to hand to a person.

card.record_format: For this dataset, `input` is `{capability, request}` (a `coga.request` v1) and `expected` is `{kind: "artifact", output: <coga.artifact>}` or `{kind: "error", output: {code, message, details}}`. Artifacts validate against the artifact schema the pinned engine ships; `artifact_id` identifies the result and `coga replay` recomputes it.
intended_use: Training and evaluating models to express problems as explicit, checkable reasoning structures (claims, evidence, tasks, criteria, risks) rather than free text.
Regression testing CogA: the `regression` split pins exact engine outputs.
Robustness evaluation with the `adversarial` split (injection, smuggled fields, contradictions).
out_of_scope: Training on hidden or free-form chain-of-thought: the dataset has none and must not be extended with any.
Treating CogA results as decisions: they measure the structure supplied, they do not recommend.
Training on test, holdout, adversarial or regression records.
limitations: All tasks are synthetic and authored for this dataset; they are realistic in shape but not drawn from real incidents.
Expected outputs are what CogA 2.0.0 computes, not human judgements of the best answer.
Variants within a family share structure, so the effective diversity is the number of families, not records.
